registryBasis: Punjab Urban Land Systems Enhancement (PULSE), a Government of Punjab land-system project, exposes a public GIS viewer and the Punjab Land Records Authority ArcGIS service. The Sheikhupura service layer includes Muridke Tehsil and returned a safe parcel polygon at the exact WUP point.
technicalResult: The official PULSE viewer configuration exposed /api/gis/token; using that anonymous viewer flow, the ArcGIS REST service was queried without login. The Sheikhupura layer (31) returned one polygon intersecting the exact WUP point. Query output was requested as GeoJSON in EPSG:4326; source layer metadata reports WKID 102100/latestWkid 3857.
